entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anne Marie Vallotton was a Swiss and French artist best known for her illustrations in the Good News Bible. According to HarperCollins, Vallotton is the bestselling artist of all time, thanks to worldwide sales of the Good News Bible in excess of 225 million.
